articles.title: Lift at Derker Tram Stop Out of Service Until Further Notice
articles.excerpt: The lift at Derker tram stop is currently out of service, affecting access for passengers. Alternative step-free routes are available for travel towards and away from Manchester.
articles.content_html:
The lift at Derker tram stop is out of service as of 6:30pm on 14 August 2026, and will remain unavailable until further notice. This disruption affects passengers using the tram service in both directions.

For those travelling towards Manchester, step-free access can be achieved via a ramp from Cromford Street directly to the Manchester-bound platform. Passengers heading towards Rochdale can also use a ramp from Cromford Street, but must cross the tracks to reach the Rochdale-bound platform.

Transport for Greater Manchester (TfGM) has apologised for any inconvenience caused by this disruption and is advising passengers to plan their journeys accordingly.

Further updates regarding the lift's status will be provided as they become available. For more information, passengers can visit the TfGM travel alerts page.
